scope: Finite read-only source audit for T-2980 preparation; no implementation, runtime test or photographic acceptance

declaredInventory.countLimits: 86 is the sum of source rows in the three indexed records with wagons:80 town_trade_goods+1 town_water_cart+5 town_trade_yards.80 in the earlier ticket/PR is the town_trade_goods group, not the complete index. Actual emitted census filters hostMissing, missing/invalid at_local_enu_m and groundAt refusal; near/far/Light visibility and replacement fallback can hide already-built meshes without removing their record/census. No runtime census was measured in this audit.

variation.seed: Exact extracted hashOf/streamOf source; FNV-1a32 over JS parts.join("|") with ["wagon", originalId, exactE, exactN]; no scene, bearing, kind or row index enters wagonCoat seed.
variation.stream: Mulberry32-style source stream; seed0 becomes1; increments0x6d2b79f5, uses Math.imul/unsigned shifts.
variation.additional: Next draws shade the floor,8 side/end boards,and6 stakes; fixed geometry, not random body/arch deformation. Grain UV offsets use another hash of world primitive center rounded to centimetres, including terrain-dependent Y, over a4.48m tile; canvas disables grain.
variation.linearColorLimit: Nominal uncached linear triples are computed analytically from sRGB and exact scalar. Actual toneOf caches by hex+k.toFixed(3), so a previous nearby scalar may be reused; these triples are not claimed actual framebuffer colors or a full emitV replay.
variation.geometry: All18 covered rows share body/wheel/arch dimensions.17 add laid-by yoke geometry; GreenTree shed wagon has none. Orientation,exactplace,slew and host/shed context vary. No covered row supplies load/cargo/content/item/mark data.
